definition_zh: 远离某个地方或事物的内部

definition: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it
example: I'm seeing a patient—please wait outside.
definition_zh: 不是在房间、建筑或容器内，而是在其内部或外部
example_zh: 我正在看病人——请在外面等。

definition: across a street, an open space, etc.
example: I stopped and crossed over.
definition_zh: 过街、开阔地带等等。
example_zh: 我停下来，然后跨过去了。

definition: resting on the surface of somebody/something and partly or completely covering them/it
example: She put a blanket over the sleeping child.
definition_zh: 停在某人/某物表面，并部分或完全覆盖其表面
example_zh: 她给熟睡的孩子盖上了毯子。

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用来强调某物属于某人或与某人有关

definition: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: It was her own idea.
definition_zh: 用来强调某物属于某人或与某人有关

definition: one side or both sides of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, etc.
example: Turn to page 64.
definition_zh: 书本、杂志等纸张的一面或两面。

definition: a liquid that is put on surfaces to give them a particular colour; a layer of this liquid when it has dried on a surface
example: white paint
definition_zh: 一种液体，被涂抹在表面上，使其呈现特定颜色;干燥后该液体在表面上形成的一层

definition: to cover a surface or object with paint
example: paint something with something, Paint the shed with weather-resistant paint.
definition_zh: 用颜料覆盖表面或物体
example_zh: 用什么东西来刷东西，给棚子刷一涂耐候漆。

definition: a picture that has been painted
example: a watercolour/crylic painting
definition_zh: 一幅已经被描绘出来的画面

definition: two things of the same type, especially when they are used or worn together
example: a pair of shoes/boots
definition_zh: 这两种是同一种东西，尤其是当它们一起使用或佩戴时

definition: the thin material that you write and draw on and that is also used for wrapping and packing things
example: a piece/sheet of paper
definition_zh: 那种你用来写字和绘画的薄材料，也用来包裹和打包东西

definition: a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph starts on a new line.
example: an opening/introductory paragraph
definition_zh: 写作中的一个部分，通常由几句话组成，涉及单一主题。段落的第一句从新一行开始。

definition: a person’s father or mother
example: He's still living with his parents.
definition_zh: 一个人的父亲或母亲

definition: an area of public land in a town or a city where people go to walk, play and relax
example: Hyde Park
definition_zh: 城镇或城市中的公共土地，人们在这里散步、玩耍和放松

definition: to leave a vehicle that you are driving in a particular place for a period of time
example: He parked and went inside.
definition_zh: 将您驾驶的车辆在特定地点停留一段时间

definition: some but not all of a thing
example: We spent part of the time in the museum.
definition_zh: 部分内容，但并非全部
example_zh: 我们有一段时间待在博物馆里。

definition: a person that you are doing an activity with, such as dancing or playing a game
example: a dance/tennis partner
definition_zh: 和你一起做某项活动的人，比如跳舞或玩游戏

definition: a social occasion, often in a person’s home, at which people eat, drink, talk, dance and enjoy themselves
example: a dinner/tea/cocktail party
definition_zh: 一种社交活动，通常在一个人家中举行，人们在此吃喝、交谈、跳舞和享受其中

definition: an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country, and that you may have to show when you enter or leave a country
example: a valid passport
definition_zh: 一份官方文件，用于证明你是某一国家的公民，并且你在进出某个国家时可能需要出示

definition: gone by in time
example: in past years/centuries
definition_zh: 在时间上已经过去的
example_zh: 在过去的几年/几个世纪里

definition: the time that has gone by; things that happened in an earlier time
example: in the past, I used to go there often in the past.
definition_zh: 已经过去的时间；较早发生的事情

definition: later than something
example: half past two
definition_zh: 晚于某个时间

definition: to give somebody money for work, goods, services, etc.
example: Who's paying?
definition_zh: 给某人工作、商品、服务等钱。

definition: an instrument made of plastic or metal used for writing with ink (= coloured liquid for writing, etc.)
example: an ink pen
definition_zh: 一种由塑料或金属制成、用于用墨水书写的工具（=用于书写的彩色液体等）

definition: a narrow piece of wood, or a metal or plastic case, containing a black or coloured substance, used for drawing or writing
example: I'll get a pencil and paper.
definition_zh: 一块狭长的木头，或金属或塑料盒，内含黑色或彩色物质，用于绘画或书写

definition: human beings; men, women and children
example: At least ten people were killed in the crash.
definition_zh: 人类;男人、女人和儿童
example_zh: 事故造成至少十人死亡。

definition: a powder made from dried berries (called peppercorns), used to give a hot, spicy taste to food
example: Season with salt and pepper
definition_zh: 一种由干浆果制成的粉末（称为胡椒粒），用来赋予食物辛辣的口感

definition: having everything that is necessary; complete and without faults or weaknesses
example: in perfect condition
definition_zh: 具备一切必要的条件;完整无瑕，没有任何缺陷或弱点

definition: a particular length of time
example: a long/an extended period
definition_zh: 特定时间长度

definition: a human as an individual
example: What sort of person would do a thing like that?
definition_zh: 作为个体的人类
example_zh: 什么样的人会做出那样的事？

definition: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else
example: The novel is written from personal experience.
definition_zh: 属于你自己的;不属于任何人，也不与任何人有联系
example_zh: 这部小说基于个人经历而成。

definition: a piece of equipment for talking to people who are not in the same place as you
example: I have to make a phone call.
definition_zh: 一件用来与不在你身处同一地点的人交流的设备

definition: to make a phone call to somebody
example: I was just phoning up for a chat.
definition_zh: 给某人打个电话

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: a colour/black-and-white photo
definition_zh: 一种使用以数字形式存储图像的相机拍摄的照片，或者内部含有对光敏感的胶片

definition: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
example: aerial photographs of the crash site
definition_zh: 一种使用以数字形式存储图像的相机拍摄的照片，或者内部含有对光敏感的胶片

definition: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together
example: a memorable/catchy phrase
definition_zh: 一组在一起使用时具有特定含义的词
example_zh: 一个令人难忘/朗朗上口的短语

definition: a large musical instrument played by pressing the black and white keys on the keyboard. The sound is produced by small hammers hitting the metal strings inside the piano.
example: to play the piano
definition_zh: 这是一种大型乐器，通过按下键盘上的黑白键来演奏。声音由小锤子敲击钢琴内部的金属弦产生。

definition: a painting or drawing, etc. that shows a scene, a person or thing
example: He likes books with lots of pictures in them.
definition_zh: 一幅画、一幅画，等，用来表现一个场景、一个人或某物
example_zh: 他喜欢有很多图片的书。

definition: an amount of something that has been cut or separated from the rest of it; a standard amount of something
example: piece of something, She wrote something on a small piece of paper.
definition_zh: 一种被切割或从其他部分分离出来的某样东西的数量;一个标准数量的某样东西
example_zh: 某物的碎片，她在一张小纸上写了些什么。

definition: an animal with pink, black or brown skin, short legs, a broad nose and a short curly tail. Pigs are kept on farms for their meat (called pork) or live in the wild.
example: a pig farmer
definition_zh: 一种拥有粉色、黑色或棕色皮肤、短腿、宽鼻子和短卷尾的动物。猪被养在农场中作为肉（称为猪肉）或野外生活。

definition: pale red in colour
example: pale pink roses
definition_zh: 颜色为浅红色

definition: the colour that is produced when you mix red and white together
example: She was dressed in pink.
definition_zh: 当你把红色和白色混合在一起时产生的颜色

definition: a particular position, point or area
example: in a place, Keep your purse in a safe place.
definition_zh: 特定位置、点或区域
example_zh: 放在一个地方，把你的钱包放在安全的地方。

definition: something that you intend to do or achieve
example: plan for something, Do you have any plans for the summer?
definition_zh: 你打算做或实现的事情
example_zh: 计划点什么，你夏天有什么计划吗？

definition: to make detailed arrangements for something you want to do in the future
example: plan something, to plan a trip
definition_zh: 为你未来想做的事情做详细安排
example_zh: 计划点什么，计划一次旅行

definition: a flying vehicle with wings and one or more engines
example: a passenger/fighter/military/private plane
definition_zh: 一种带有机翼和一台或多台发动机的飞行器
example_zh: 客机/战斗机/军用/私人飞机

definition: a living thing that grows in the earth and usually has a stem, leaves and roots, especially one that is smaller than a tree or bush
example: All plants need light and water.
definition_zh: 一种生长在土壤中的生物，通常有茎、叶和根，尤其是比树或灌木还小的那种
example_zh: 所有植物都需要光和水。

definition: a piece of writing performed by actors in a theatre or on television or radio
example: a stage/radio play
definition_zh: 由演员在剧院或电视或广播中表演的文字作品

definition: to do things for pleasure, as children do; to enjoy yourself, rather than work
example: You'll have to play inside today.
definition_zh: 像孩子那样为了乐趣而做事;享受生活，而不是工作

definition: a person who takes part in a game or sport
example: a football/tennis/chess player
definition_zh: 参与游戏或体育运动的人
example_zh: 一名足球/网球/国际象棋选手

definition: used as a polite way of asking for something or telling somebody to do something
example: Please sit down.
definition_zh: 作为礼貌的请求或命令某人做某事的方式

definition: a thing that somebody says or writes giving their opinion or stating a fact
example: She made several interesting points in the article.
definition_zh: 某人说或写的话，表达了自己的观点或陈述了事实
example_zh: 她在文章中提出了几个有趣的观点。

definition: an official organization whose job is to make people obey the law and to prevent and solve crime; the people who work for this organization
example: Get out of the house or I'll call the police.
definition_zh: 一个官方组织，其职责是让人们遵守法律、预防和侦破犯罪;为该组织工作的人员

definition: a male police officer
example: a plain-clothes/uniformed policeman
definition_zh: 一名男性警察

definition: an area of water that has been created for people to swim in
example: an indoor/outdoor pool
definition_zh: 这是一个专门为人们游泳而设立的水域

definition: having very little money; not having enough money for basic needs
example: They were too poor to buy shoes for the kids.
definition_zh: 几乎没有钱;连基本生活所需都不够
example_zh: 他们穷得连给孩子们买鞋都买不起。

definition: liked or enjoyed by a large number of people
example: Andalucia is a popular tourist destination.
definition_zh: 被大量人喜爱或喜爱
example_zh: 安达卢西亚是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。

definition: good or useful
example: The tests have so far yielded positive results.
definition_zh: 良好或有用
example_zh: 到目前为止，这些检测结果都是阳性。

definition: that can be done or achieved
example: possible to do something, New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.
definition_zh: 这是可以做到或实现的
example_zh: 新技术使得沟通变得更加轻松，变得更为便利。

definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: by post, I'll send the original to you by post.
definition_zh: 用于发送和投递信件、包裹等的官方系统。
example_zh: 我会通过邮寄方式把原件寄给你。

definition: to send a letter, etc. to somebody by post
example: post something, The cost of posting a letter has gone up again.
definition_zh: 通过邮寄方式给某人寄信等
example_zh: 寄点东西，寄信的费用又涨了。

definition: a round white vegetable with a brown or red skin that grows underground as part of a plant also called a potato
example: Will you peel the potatoes for me?
definition_zh: 一种圆形白色蔬菜，带棕色或红色皮，生长在地下，作为植物的一部分，也被称为土豆

definition: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence
example: a ten-pound note
definition_zh: 英国货币单位，价值100便士

definition: doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this
example: conversation practice
definition_zh: 定期进行某项活动或训练，以便提升技能;你为此所花费的时间

definition: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill
example: You need to practise every day.
definition_zh: 定期进行活动或训练，以便提升技能

definition: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better
example: prefer something, ‘Coffee or tea?’ ‘I'd prefer tea, thanks.’
definition_zh: 喜欢某件事或某人胜过另一件;因为你更喜欢某样东西而选择某样东西而不是别的
example_zh: 想要点什么，'咖啡还是茶？''我更喜欢茶，谢谢。'

definition: to make something or somebody ready to be used or to do something
example: prepare something/somebody, to prepare a report
definition_zh: 让某物或某人变得准备好被使用或完成某事
example_zh: 准备某样东西或某人，准备一份报告

definition: existing or happening now
example: I am not satisfied with the present situation.
definition_zh: 正在进行或正在进行的
example_zh: 我对目前的状况并不满意。

definition: a thing that you give to somebody as a gift
example: What can I get him for a birthday present?
definition_zh: 你送给别人作为礼物的东西
example_zh: 我可以送他什么生日礼物？

definition: attractive without being very beautiful
example: a pretty face
definition_zh: 有吸引力却不至于特别漂亮

definition: to some extent; fairly
example: The game was pretty good.
definition_zh: 在某种程度上;相当

definition: the amount of money that you have to pay for something
example: Boat for sale, price £8 000
definition_zh: 你必须为某项商品支付的金额

definition: used to say that something is likely to happen or to be true
example: You're probably right.
definition_zh: 过去常说某件事很可能会发生或者可能是真的

definition: a thing that is difficult to deal with or to understand
example: big/serious/major problems
definition_zh: 一件难以应对或理解的事情

definition: a thing that is grown, produced or created, usually for sale
example: food/agricultural/software products
definition_zh: 一种被种植、生产或创造出来的东西，通常用于出售

definition: something that people watch on television or listen to on the radio
example: a news programme
definition_zh: 人们在电视上观看或在广播中听的东西

definition: a piece of work involving careful study of a subject over a period of time, done by school or college students
example: a history project
definition_zh: 一项由学校或大学生在一段时间内认真研究某一主题的作品

definition: having the colour of blue and red mixed together
example: a purple flower/dress
definition_zh: 蓝色和红色混合在一起

definition: the colour of blue and red mixed together
example: Her hair was dyed a bright shade of purple.
definition_zh: 蓝色和红色混在一起
example_zh: 她的头发染成了明亮的紫色。

definition: to move something into a particular place or position
example: Put the cases down there, please.
definition_zh: 将某物移动到特定位置或位置

definition: one of four equal parts of something
example: quarter of something, a quarter of an hour/a century
definition_zh: 是某物的四个相等部分之一
example_zh: 二十五分之一小时，十五分钟/一百年

definition: a sentence, phrase or word that asks for information
example: You didn't answer my question.
definition_zh: 一个请求信息的句子、短语或词

definition: done with speed; taking or lasting a short time
example: a quick look/check/search
definition_zh: 以速度完成;需要或坚持短时间

definition: fast
example: She walked quickly away.
definition_zh: 快

definition: making very little noise
example: her quiet voice
definition_zh: 几乎没有什么声音

definition: to some degree
example: quite good/interesting/common/difficult
definition_zh: 在某种程度上
example_zh: 相当不错/有趣/常见/困难

definition: the activity of broadcasting programmes for people to listen to; the programmes that are broadcast
example: The play was written specially for radio.
definition_zh: 为公众提供收听的节目广播活动;播出的节目

definition: water that falls from the sky in separate drops
example: There will be rain in all parts tomorrow.
definition_zh: 从天而降的水滴分成独立的水滴

definition: when it rains, water falls from the sky in drops
example: Is it raining?
definition_zh: 下雨时，雨水从天而降，成滴如雨。

definition: to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols
example: She's still learning to read.
definition_zh: 查看并理解书面或印刷文字或符号的含义

definition: a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way
example: an avid reader of science fiction
definition_zh: 一个会阅读的人，尤其是那种阅读很多或以特定方式阅读的人
example_zh: 一位热衷科幻小说的读者

definition: the activity of somebody who reads
example: My hobbies include reading and painting.
definition_zh: 阅读者的活动
example_zh: 我的爱好包括阅读和绘画。

definition: fully prepared for what you are going to do and able to start it immediately
example: Just a minute—I'm almost ready.
definition_zh: 完全准备好你要做的事情，并能立即开始

definition: actually existing or happening and not imagined or pretended
example: a real danger/risk/threat/concern
definition_zh: 真实存在或正在发生，而不是想象或假装
example_zh: 真正的危险/风险/威胁/关切

definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb
example: That's a really good idea.
definition_zh: 用于强调形容词或副词

definition: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done
example: He said no but he didn't give a reason.
definition_zh: 对某件事的某种原因或解释，或者某件事发生了什么，或者某人做了什么

definition: having the colour of blood or fire
example: bright/light/dark red lipstick
definition_zh: 拥有血色或火焰色

definition: the colour of blood or fire
example: She often wears red.
definition_zh: 血的颜色或火焰的颜色

definition: to rest while you are doing something that you enjoy, especially after work or effort
example: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
definition_zh: 在做自己喜欢的事情时休息，尤其是在下班或努力之后
example_zh: 放松，好好享受这部电影。

definition: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past
example: remember somebody/something, This is Carla. Do you remember her?
definition_zh: 在记忆中拥有或保留一个关于过去事件、一个人、地点等的画面
example_zh: 记得某个人/某物，这是卡拉。你还记得她吗？

definition: to say or write something again or more than once
example: repeat something, to repeat a question/a claim/an assertion/a warning
definition_zh: 再次或多次说出或写下某事
example_zh: 重复某事，重复一个问题/说法/断言/警告

definition: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast
example: Are these news reports true?
definition_zh: 对某一事件的书面或口头叙述，尤其是被发表或广播的事件
example_zh: 这些新闻报道是真的吗？

definition: a place where you can buy and eat a meal
example: We're going to try this Italian restaurant that just opened.
definition_zh: 一个你可以买饭吃饭的地方
example_zh: 我们要去试试这家刚开业的意大利餐厅。

definition: a thing that is caused or produced because of something else
example: And did your intervention produce the desired result?
definition_zh: 一种因其他原因而引起或产生的东西
example_zh: 你的干预是否达到了预期效果？

definition: the action of arriving in or coming back to a place that you were in before
example: return of somebody to…, A week had passed since their return to Geneva.
definition_zh: 到达或回到你曾经所在的地方的行为
example_zh: 某人返回......他们回到日内瓦已经过去一周。

definition: to come or go back from one place to another
example: I waited a long time for him to return.
definition_zh: 来回，从一个地方到另一个地方

definition: short, narrow white or brown grain grown on wet land in hot countries as food; the plant that produces this grain
example: a grain of rice
definition_zh: 在炎热地区湿地生长的短小、狭长的白色或棕色谷物作为食物;生产该谷物的植物

definition: having a lot of money or property
example: She's one of the richest women in the world.
definition_zh: 拥有大量资金或财产
example_zh: 她是世界上最富有的女人之一。

definition: to sit on an animal, especially a horse, and control it as it moves
example: I learnt to ride as a child.
definition_zh: 骑在动物身上，尤其是马身上，并控制它移动的过程
example_zh: 我小时候就学会骑马了。

definition: true or correct as a fact
example: Did you get the answer right?
definition_zh: 作为事实是真实的

definition: on or to the right side
example: Turn right at the end of the street.
definition_zh: 在右侧或右侧

definition: the right side or direction
example: on the right, Take the first street on the right.
definition_zh: 右侧或方向

definition: a natural flow of water that continues in a long line across land to the sea
example: Eventually we came to the mouth of the River Thames.
definition_zh: 水流自然流淌，沿着一条长线贯穿陆地直至大海
example_zh: 最终我们来到了泰晤士河口。

definition: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on
example: a main/major/minor road
definition_zh: 一种为车辆行驶而设计的坚硬表面
example_zh: 一条主干道/主干道/次要道路

definition: a part of a building that has its own walls, floor and ceiling and is usually used for a particular purpose
example: I heard him enter the room.
definition_zh: 建筑物中拥有独立墙体、地板和天花板的部分，通常用于特定用途

definition: the normal order and way in which you regularly do things
example: to settle/get/fall into a routine
definition_zh: 你平时做事的正常顺序和方式

definition: a statement of what may, must or must not be done in a particular situation or when playing a game
example: She laid down strict rules for her tenants, including prompt payment of rent.
definition_zh: 关于在特定情境或玩游戏时可以、必须或不应该做什么的陈述
example_zh: 她为租户制定了严格的规则，包括必须及时支付房租。

definition: to move using your legs, going faster than when you walk
example: Can you run as fast as Mike?
definition_zh: 用腿移动，比走路时更快
example_zh: 你能跑得跟迈克一样快吗？

definition: unhappy or showing unhappiness
example: sad to do something, We are very sad to hear that you are leaving.
definition_zh: 不开心或表现出不开心
example_zh: 做点什么很难过，我们非常难过听说你要离开。

definition: a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, tomato and cucumber, usually served with other food as part of a meal
example: All main courses come with salad or vegetables.
definition_zh: 生菜、西红柿和黄瓜等生蔬菜混合物，通常作为正餐的一部分搭配其他食物
example_zh: 所有主菜都配有沙拉或蔬菜。

definition: a white substance that is added to food to make it taste better or to preserve it. Salt is obtained from mines and is also found in seawater. It is sometimes called common salt to show that it is different from other chemical salts. Its chemical name is sodium chloride.
example: Pass the salt, please.
definition_zh: 一种白色物质，添加到食物中，以提升其味道或保存食物。盐来自矿井，也存在于海水中。有时称为普通盐，以表明它与其他化学盐不同。它的化学名称是氯化钠。

definition: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different
example: We have lived in the same house for twenty years.
definition_zh: 正是上述提及或提及的那一或几种;没有区别
example_zh: 我们在同一所房子里住了二十年。

definition: in the same way
example: We treat boys exactly the same as girls.
definition_zh: 以同样的方式
example_zh: 我们对待男孩和女孩完全一样。

definition: the same thing or things
example: I would do the same again.
definition_zh: 同样的事情或类似的东西

definition: two slices of bread, often spread with butter, with a layer of meat, cheese, etc. between them
example: a ham/tuna/egg sandwich
definition_zh: 两片面包，通常抹上黄油，中间夹着一层肉、奶酪等
example_zh: 火腿/金枪鱼/鸡蛋三明治

definition: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday
example: It's Saturday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 星期五之后、周日之前的星期几

definition: to speak or tell somebody something, using words
example: + speech, ‘Hello!’ she said.
definition_zh: 用语言向某人说话或告诉某人一些事情

definition: a place where children go to be educated
example: My brother and I went to the same school.
definition_zh: 一个孩子们去接受教育的地方
example_zh: 我和哥哥曾就读同一所学校。

definition: knowledge about the structure and behaviour of the natural and physical world, based on facts that you can prove, for example by experiments
example: new developments in science and technology
definition_zh: 基于可以证明的事实，例如通过实验，了解自然和物理世界的结构与行为

definition: a person who studies one or more of the natural sciences (= for example, physics, chemistry or biology)
example: a research scientist
definition_zh: 学习一种或多种自然科学（=例如物理、化学或生物学）的人

definition: the salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface and surrounds its continents and islands
example: The waste was dumped in the sea.
definition_zh: 覆盖地球大部分表面、环绕大陆和岛屿的咸水

definition: happening or coming next after the first in a series of similar things or people; 2nd
example: This is the second time it's happened.
definition_zh: 在一系列类似的事情或人物中，发生或紧接着出现;第二个
example_zh: 这是第二次发生这种情况了。

definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 seconds in one minute.
example: in… seconds, She can run 100 metres in just over 11 seconds.
definition_zh: 一种用于测量时间的单位。一分钟里有60秒。
example_zh: 在......秒内，她能在11秒多一点内跑完100米。

definition: happening or coming next after the first in a series of similar things or people; 2nd
example: This is the second time it's happened.
definition_zh: 在一系列类似的事情或人物中，发生或紧接着出现;第二个
example_zh: 这是第二次发生这种情况了。

definition: any of the parts into which something is divided
example: section of something, That section of the road is still closed.
definition_zh: 任何将某物划分为部分的部分
example_zh: 某段路，那段路还封闭着。

definition: to become aware of somebody/something by using your eyes
example: see somebody/something, She looked for him but couldn't see him in the crowd.
definition_zh: 通过用眼睛感知某个人或某物
example_zh: 看到某个人/什么东西，她找他，但在人群中没看到他。

definition: to give something to somebody in exchange for money
example: sell (something), I recently sold my bike.
definition_zh: 把东西送给别人，换取钱
example_zh: 卖了（某样东西），我最近卖了我的自行车。

definition: to make something go or be taken to a place, especially by post, email, radio, etc.
example: send something, She sent a letter of support.
definition_zh: 使某物前往或被带到某个地方，尤其是通过邮寄、电子邮件、无线电等方式。
example_zh: 寄送某物，她寄出了一封支持信。

definition: a set of words expressing a statement, a question or an order, usually containing a subject and a verb. In written English sentences begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop/period (.), a question mark (?) or an exclamation mark (!).
example: Does the sentence contain an adverb?
definition_zh: 一组表达陈述、疑问或命令的词，通常包含主语和动词。在书面英语句子中，句子以大写字母开头，以句号（.）、问号（？）或感叹号（！）结尾。

definition: the 9th month of the year, between August and October
example: She was born in September.
definition_zh: 每年第九个月，8月至10月之间

example: There are seven cookies left.

definition: the number 17
example: She is seventeen years old.
definition_zh: 数字17

definition: the number 70
example: More than seventy people attended the meeting.
definition_zh: 数字70
example_zh: 超过七十人参加了会议。

definition: to have, use or experience something at the same time as somebody else
example: There isn't an empty table. Would you mind sharing?
definition_zh: 与他人同时拥有、使用或体验某物
example_zh: 没有空桌。你介意分享一下吗？

definition: a female person or animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: ‘What does your sister do?’ ‘She's a dentist.’
definition_zh: 已提及或易于识别的女性或动物
example_zh: “你姐姐是做什么的？”“她是一名牙医。”

definition: an animal with a thick coat, kept on farms for its meat (called mutton or lamb) or its wool
example: a flock of sheep
definition_zh: 一种被毛厚实的动物，饲养在农场以获取肉类（称为羊肉或羔羊）或羊毛

definition: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body, made of light cloth, with sleeves and usually with a collar and buttons down the front
example: to wear a shirt
definition_zh: 一种穿在上半身的衣服，材质轻薄，有袖子，通常前方有领子和扣子

definition: one of a pair of objects usually made of leather or plastic that you wear on your feet
example: a pair of shoes
definition_zh: 通常是一对皮革或塑料制成、你穿在脚上的物品之一

definition: a building or part of a building where you can buy goods or services
example: to open/close/run a shop
definition_zh: 一栋建筑或其部分，您可以购买商品或服务

definition: to buy things in shops
example: I shop there from time to time.
definition_zh: 在商店里买东西

definition: the activity of going to shops and buying things or ordering them online
example: to go shopping
definition_zh: 去商店购买或在线订购物品的活动

definition: measuring or covering a small length or distance, or a smaller length or distance than usual
example: He had short curly hair.
definition_zh: 测量或覆盖较小的长度或距离，或比平时更小的长度或距离

definition: used to show what is right, appropriate, etc., especially when criticizing somebody’s actions
example: You shouldn't drink and drive.
definition_zh: 用来展示什么是正确、合适的等，尤其是在批评某人的行为时

definition: a programme on television or the radio
example: Millions of people watch the show.
definition_zh: 电视或广播节目
example_zh: 数百万人观看这部节目。

definition: to make something clear; to prove something
example: show (that)…, The figures clearly show that her claims are false.
definition_zh: 为了让某件事变得清晰;为了证明一些什么
example_zh: 证明（该）......数据清楚地表明她的说法是虚假的。

definition: a piece of equipment producing a flow of water that you stand under to wash yourself; the small room or part of a room that contains a shower
example: in the shower, He's in the shower.
definition_zh: 一件产生水流的设备，你站在下面洗澡;带有淋浴的小房间或房间的一部分

definition: physically or mentally ill
example: a sick child
definition_zh: 身体或精神疾病

definition: like somebody/something but not exactly the same
example: We have very similar interests.
definition_zh: 像是某个人/某物，但又不完全一样

definition: to make musical sounds with your voice in the form of a song or tune
example: I just can't sing in tune!
definition_zh: 用你的声音发出歌曲或旋律的音乐声音

definition: a person who sings, or whose job is singing, especially in public
example: She's a wonderful singer.
definition_zh: 一个会唱歌的人，或者说他的职业是唱歌，尤其是在公共场合唱歌

definition: a girl or woman who has the same mother and father as another person
example: She's my sister.
definition_zh: 一个女孩或女人，与另一个人有同一个父母

definition: to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on/in a chair
example: She sat and stared at the letter in front of her.
definition_zh: 让身体压在臀部上，背部挺直，比如坐在椅子上或椅子上

definition: all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place
example: the present economic/financial/political situation
definition_zh: 在特定时间、特定地点发生的所有情况和事情
example_zh: 当前的经济/金融/政治形势

example: There are six cookies left.

definition: the number 16
example: He started learning English at sixteen.
definition_zh: 数字16
example_zh: 他十六岁时开始学习英语。

definition: the number 60
example: There are sixty minutes in an hour.
definition_zh: 数字60

definition: the ability to do something well
example: The job requires skill and an eye for detail.
definition_zh: 把某件事做好的能力
example_zh: 这项工作需要技巧和对细节的敏锐观察。

definition: a piece of clothing that hangs from the middle part of the body
example: a short/long/pleated/denim skirt
definition_zh: 一件从身体中部垂挂的衣物
example_zh: 短裙/长裙/百褶裙/牛仔裙

definition: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active
example: Let her sleep—it'll do her good.
definition_zh: 闭上眼睛休息，身心不活动
example_zh: 让她睡觉吧——这对她有好处。

definition: not moving, acting or done quickly; taking a long time; not fast
example: a slow pace/speed
definition_zh: 不动、不行动或迅速完成;耗时过长;不快

definition: not large in size, number, degree, amount, etc.
example: a small town/village/community
definition_zh: 规模、数量、程度、数量等都不大。

definition: a reptile with a very long thin body and no legs. There are many types of snake, some of which are poisonous.
example: a snake coiled up in the grass
definition_zh: 一种爬行动物，身体非常细长，没有腿。蛇种类繁多，其中一些有毒。
example_zh: 一条盘踞在草丛中的蛇

definition: small soft white pieces (called flakes) of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather; this substance when it is lying on the ground
example: Snow was falling heavily.
definition_zh: 寒冷天气中从天空飘落的小块柔软白色冰水碎片（称为冰片）;这种物质躺在地面时

definition: when it snows, snow falls from the sky
example: It's been snowing heavily all day.
definition_zh: 下雪时，雪从天而降

definition: to such a great degree
example: Don't look so angry.
definition_zh: 在如此巨大的程度上

definition: used to show the reason for something
example: It was still painful, so I went to see a doctor.
definition_zh: 用来展示某事的理由
example_zh: 还是很疼，所以我去看了医生。

definition: used with uncountable nouns or plural countable nouns to mean ‘an amount of’ or ‘a number of’, when the amount or number is not given
example: There's some milk in the fridge.
definition_zh: 与不可数名词或复数可数名词一起使用，表示“数量”或“数量”，但未给出数量或数量时

definition: used to refer to an amount of something or a number of people or things when the amount or number is not given
example: Some disapprove of the idea.
definition_zh: 用于指某物或人数的数量，当未给出数量或数量时
example_zh: 有些人不赞成这个想法。

definition: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: Somebody should have told me.
definition_zh: 一个未被知晓或未被提及的人

definition: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: There's someone at the door.
definition_zh: 一个未被知晓或未被提及的人

definition: a thing that is not known or mentioned by name
example: We stopped for something to eat.
definition_zh: 一个既不被知道，也未被提及的名字的东西

definition: occasionally rather than all of the time
example: Sometimes I go by car.
definition_zh: 偶尔而非每次

definition: a person’s male child
example: their four-year-old son
definition_zh: 一个人的男性子女

definition: a short piece of music with words that you sing
example: a love/pop/rock song
definition_zh: 一段你唱出的短小音乐，配有歌词
example_zh: 一首爱情/流行/摇滚歌曲

definition: in a short time from now; a short time after something else has happened
example: She sold the house soon after her husband died.
definition_zh: 再过不久;在发生别的事情之后不久
example_zh: 丈夫去世后不久，她卖掉了房子。

definition: feeling sad and ashamed about something that has been done
example: sorry about something, We're very sorry about the damage to your car.
definition_zh: 为已经发生的事情感到难过和羞愧
example_zh: 很抱歉，我们对您的车子受损感到非常抱歉。

definition: used when you are apologizing for something
example: Sorry I'm late!
definition_zh: 用于你为某事道歉时

definition: something that you can hear
example: a loud/soft/faint sound
definition_zh: 你能听见的东西
example_zh: 一种响亮/轻微/微弱的声音

definition: to give a particular impression when heard or read about
example: + adj., to sound good/great/right/interesting
definition_zh: 在听到或阅读时，给人一种特定的印象
example_zh: + 形容词，听起来好听/很棒/正确/有趣

definition: a liquid food made by boiling meat, vegetables, etc. in water, often eaten as the first course of a meal
example: a bowl/cup of soup
definition_zh: 一种用水炖煮肉类、蔬菜等制成的液体食物，常作为一餐的第一道菜食用

definition: in or towards the south
example: South Wales
definition_zh: 在南方或向南

definition: towards the south
example: This room faces south.
definition_zh: 向南

definition: the direction that is on your right when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is south?
definition_zh: 你看日出时右手边的方向;指南针的四个主要方向之一

definition: the area outside the earth’s atmosphere where all the other planets and stars are
example: in space, Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman in space.
definition_zh: 地球大气层之外的区域，所有其他行星和恒星都在那里
example_zh: 在太空中，瓦莲京娜·捷列什科娃是第一位进入太空的女性。

definition: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody
example: speak to somebody, The President refused to speak to reporters.
definition_zh: 和某人谈论某件事;与某人进行对话
example_zh: 找人说话，总统拒绝接受记者采访。

definition: not ordinary or usual; different from what is normal
example: The school will only allow this in special circumstances.
definition_zh: 既不普通也不常见;不同于正常的
example_zh: 学校只在特殊情况下允许这样做。

definition: to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order
example: How do you spell your surname?
definition_zh: 以正确的顺序说或写出单词的字母

definition: the act of forming words correctly from individual letters; the ability to do this
example: the differences between British and American spelling
definition_zh: 从单个字母正确组成单词的行为;做到这一点的能力
example_zh: 英式与美式拼写的差异

definition: to give money to pay for goods, services, etc.
example: spend something, I've spent all my money already.
definition_zh: 用钱支付商品、服务等。
example_zh: 花点钱吧，我已经把钱都花光了。

definition: activity that you do for pleasure and that needs physical effort or skill, usually done in a special area and according to fixed rules
example: There are excellent facilities for sport and recreation.
definition_zh: 你为了娱乐而进行的活动，需要体力或技巧，通常在特定区域并按照固定规则进行
example_zh: 这里拥有优良的体育和休闲设施。

definition: the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow
example: The following spring, the three artists travelled to California.
definition_zh: 冬夏之间的季节，植物开始生长
example_zh: 次年春天，三位艺术家前往加利福尼亚。

definition: to be on your feet; to be in a vertical position
example: She was too weak to stand.
definition_zh: 站立;保持垂直姿势

definition: a large ball of burning gas in space that we see as a point of light in the sky at night
example: There was a big moon and hundreds of stars were shining overhead.
definition_zh: 一个巨大的燃烧气体球，位于太空中，夜晚我们看到它作为天空中的一道光点
example_zh: 那天有一轮大月亮，头顶上闪烁着数百颗星星。

definition: to begin doing or using something
example: start (something), I start work at nine.
definition_zh: 开始做或使用某件事
example_zh: 开始（什么）？我九点就开始上班。

definition: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion
example: Are the following statements true or false?
definition_zh: 你说或写的那些提供信息或观点的东西

definition: a place where trains stop so that passengers can get on and off; the buildings connected with this
example: the main station
definition_zh: 列车停靠，供乘客上下车;与此相连的建筑

definition: to continue to be in a particular place for a period of time without moving away
example: + adv./prep., Stay there and don't move!
definition_zh: 在某个特定地点持续停留一段时间而不离开
example_zh: + 副词/介词，待在那里别动！

definition: continuing until a particular point in time and not finishing
example: I am very happy that you all are still alive and well.
definition_zh: 持续到某个特定时间点且未完成
example_zh: 我很高兴你们都还活着，健康无恙。

definition: a place where a bus or train stops regularly for passengers to get on or off
example: I get off at the next stop.
definition_zh: 一个公交车或火车定期停靠，供乘客上下车的地方

definition: to no longer move; to make somebody/something no longer move
example: The car stopped at the traffic lights.
definition_zh: 不再移动;让某人/某物不再移动

definition: a description of events and people that the writer or speaker has invented in order to entertain people
example: a tragic love story
definition_zh: 描述作者或演讲者为娱乐人们而虚构的事件和人物

definition: a public road in a city or town that has houses and buildings on one side or both sides
example: along/down/up the street, I was just walking along the street when it happened.
definition_zh: 城市或城镇内的一条公共道路，其一侧或两侧都有房屋和建筑物
example_zh: 沿着/下/上街，我正沿着街道走着，事情就发生了。

definition: having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy weights, do hard physical work, etc.
example: He's strong enough to lift a car!
definition_zh: 拥有强大的体力，这样你才能举起重物、做高强度体力劳动等等。
example_zh: 他力气大到能举起一辆车！

definition: a person who is studying at a university or college
example: a college/university student
definition_zh: 正在大学或学院学习的人

definition: the activity of learning or gaining knowledge, either from books or by examining things in the world
example: a room set aside for private study
definition_zh: 学习或获取知识的活动，无论是通过书籍还是通过观察世间事物
example_zh: 一间专门为私人学习预留的房间

definition: to spend time learning about a subject by reading, going to college, etc.
example: He sat up very late that night, studying.
definition_zh: 花时间通过阅读、上大学等方式学习某个学科。

definition: the particular way in which something is done
example: a wide range of musical styles
definition_zh: 某事具体以何种方式进行

definition: a thing or person that is being discussed, described or dealt with
example: subject of something, Walker's work has been the subject of much debate.
definition_zh: 正在讨论、描述或处理的事物或人物
example_zh: 沃克的作品一直是争议焦点。

definition: the fact that you have achieved something that you want and have been trying to do or get
example: The company has achieved considerable success in this market.
definition_zh: 你已经实现了自己想要的东西，并且一直在努力去做或得到
example_zh: 该公司在该市场取得了相当大的成功。

definition: a sweet substance, often in the form of white or brown crystals, made from the juices of various plants, used in cooking or to make tea, coffee, etc. sweeter
example: Do you take sugar (= have it in your tea, coffee, etc.)?
definition_zh: 一种甜味物质，通常以白色或棕色晶体的形式存在，由各种植物的汁液制成，用于烹饪或让茶、咖啡等更甜
example_zh: 你会摄入糖吗（=在茶、咖啡等中加糖）？

definition: the warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn
example: in the summer, We're going away in the summer.
definition_zh: 一年中最温暖的季节，介于春季和秋季之间

example: Very few people know that.
definition_zh: 用于置于形容词、副词和限定词之前，表示“在高度程度上”或“极度”的意思

definition: a system of recording moving pictures and sound, either using a digital method of storing data or (in the past) using videotape
example: A wedding is the perfect subject for video.
definition_zh: 一种记录动态影像和声音的系统，可以采用数字存储方式，或（过去）使用录像带
example_zh: 婚礼是视频的绝佳题材。

definition: a very small town located in a country area
example: We visited towns and villages all over Spain.
definition_zh: 一个位于乡村地区的非常小镇
example_zh: 我们走访了西班牙各地的城镇和村庄。

definition: an occasion or a period of time when somebody goes to see a place or person and spends time there
example: a two-day/three-day visit
definition_zh: 某个事件或一段时间，某人去看某个地方或某个人，并在那里度过时光

definition: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time
example: My parents are coming to visit me next week.
definition_zh: 去见一个人或某个地方一段时间

definition: a person who visits a person or place
example: We've got visitors coming this weekend.
definition_zh: 访问某人或某地的人
example_zh: 这个周末我们有访客要来。

definition: to stay where you are or delay doing something until somebody/something comes or something happens
example: She rang the bell and waited.
definition_zh: 要么待在原地，要么拖延做某件事，直到有人/某物出现或者发生什么事

definition: a man whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.
example: I'll ask the waiter for the bill.
definition_zh: 一个工作是在餐厅等座位上服务顾客的人。

definition: to stop sleeping; to make somebody stop sleeping
example: I always wake early in the summer.
definition_zh: 停止睡眠;让某人停止睡眠

definition: a journey on foot, usually for pleasure or exercise
example: Let's go for a walk.
definition_zh: 徒步旅行，通常用于娱乐或锻炼

definition: to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground, but without running
example: The baby is just learning to walk.
definition_zh: 通过一只脚在地上移动或前往某个地方，但不跑

definition: a long, solid structure that rises straight up from the ground, made of stone, brick or concrete, that surrounds, divides or protects an area of land
example: to build a wall
definition_zh: 一种从地面直直升起的长而坚固的结构，由石头、砖块或混凝土制成，环绕、分隔或保护一块土地

definition: to have a desire or a wish for something/somebody
example: want somebody/something, Do you want some more tea?
definition_zh: 对某事或某人有一种渴望或愿望
example_zh: 想要某个人/什么，你还想再喝点茶吗？

definition: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold
example: warm weather/temperatures/air
definition_zh: 以相当高的温度，以一种舒适的方式，而不是冷热的感觉

definition: to make something/somebody clean using water and usually soap
example: wash something/somebody, These jeans need washing.
definition_zh: 用水，通常是肥皂，让某样东西/某人清洁
example_zh: 洗点什么/洗一个人，这条牛仔裤需要洗。

definition: a type of small clock that you wear on your wrist, or (in the past) carried in your pocket
example: She kept looking anxiously at her watch.
definition_zh: 这是一种你佩戴在手腕上的小型时钟，或者（过去）放在口袋里随身携带的时钟
example_zh: 她焦急地一直盯着手表。

definition: to look at somebody/something for a time, paying attention to what happens
example: watch somebody/something, I was in the living room, watching TV.
definition_zh: 凝视某人或某物一段时间，留意发生了什么
example_zh: 看某人/某物，我当时在客厅看电视。

definition: a liquid without colour, smell or taste that falls as rain, is in lakes, rivers and seas, and is used for drinking, washing, etc.
example: a glass of water
definition_zh: 一种没有颜色、气味或味道的液体，以雨的形式落下，存在于湖泊、河流和海洋中，用于饮用、清洗等。

definition: a method, style or manner of doing something
example: I prefer to do things the easy way.
definition_zh: 一种做事的方法、风格或方式
example_zh: 我更喜欢用简单的方式来做事。

definition: I and another person or other people; I and you
example: We've moved to Atlanta.
definition_zh: 我和另一个人或其他人;我和你

definition: to have something on your body as a piece of clothing, a decoration, etc.
example: He was wearing a new suit.
definition_zh: 比如身上有一件衣服、装饰品等等。

definition: the condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, such as the temperature, and if there is wind, rain, sun, etc.
example: cold/hot/warm/wet/dry weather
definition_zh: 指特定地点和时间的大气状况，比如温度，以及是否有风、雨、太阳等。
example_zh: 寒冷/炎热/温暖/潮湿/干燥天气

definition: a set of pages on the internet, where a company or an organization, or an individual person, puts information
example: For current prices please visit our website.
definition_zh: 互联网上的一组页面，公司、组织或个人在其中发布信息
example_zh: 如需最新价格，请访问我们的网站。

definition: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday
example: It's Wednesday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 星期二之后、星期四之前的星期几

definition: a period of seven days, either from Monday to Sunday or from Sunday to Saturday
example: last/this/next week
definition_zh: 为期七天，从周一到周日，或从周日到周六

definition: Saturday and Sunday
example: this/next/last weekend
definition_zh: 周六和周日

definition: accepted or wanted somewhere
example: I'll go, then. I know when I'm not welcome.
definition_zh: 被接受或被需要
example_zh: 那我就走。我知道自己不受欢迎。

definition: used as a greeting to tell somebody that you are pleased that they are there
example: Welcome home!
definition_zh: 用作问候语，告诉某人你很高兴他们在这里

definition: to say hello to somebody in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere
example: welcome somebody, They were at the door to welcome us.
definition_zh: 当某人到达某处时，以友好的方式打招呼
example_zh: 欢迎某位，他们在门口迎接我们。

definition: in good health
example: I don't feel very well.
definition_zh: 身体健康

definition: in a good, right or acceptable way
example: They played well in the tournament.
definition_zh: 以一种良好、正确或可接受的方式
example_zh: 他们在比赛中表现不错。

definition: used to express surprise, anger or relief
example: Well, well—I would never have guessed it!
definition_zh: 用来表达惊讶、愤怒或松一口气

definition: in or towards the west
example: West Africa
definition_zh: 在西边或向西

definition: towards the west
example: This room faces west.
definition_zh: 向西

definition: the direction that you look towards to see the sun go down; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is west?
definition_zh: 你望向太阳西下时的方向;指南针的四个主要方向之一;

definition: used in questions to ask for particular information about somebody/something
example: What is your name?
definition_zh: 用于提问，询问关于某人/某事的特定信息

definition: used in questions to ask for particular information about somebody/something
example: What is your name?
definition_zh: 用于提问，询问关于某人/某事的特定信息

definition: at what time; on what occasion
example: When did you last see him?
definition_zh: 在什么时间;在什么场合
example_zh: 你最后一次见到他是什么时候？

definition: at or during the time that
example: I loved history when I was at school.
definition_zh: 在

definition: what/which time
example: Until when can you stay?
definition_zh: 什么/什么时间

definition: in or to what place or situation
example: Where do you live?
definition_zh: 在什么地方或处于什么情况

definition: (in) the place or situation in which
example: This is where I live.
definition_zh: （in） 所在地或情形

definition: used in questions to ask somebody to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number
example: Which is better exercise—swimming or tennis?
definition_zh: 用于问题中，询问某人从有限数量中准确说明一个人或多个人或事物的情况
example_zh: 游泳和网球哪个运动更好？

definition: used in questions to ask somebody to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number
example: Which is better exercise—swimming or tennis?
definition_zh: 用于问题中，询问某人从有限数量中准确说明一个人或多个人或事物的情况
example_zh: 游泳和网球哪个运动更好？

definition: having the colour of fresh snow or of milk
example: a crisp white shirt
definition_zh: 颜色如新鲜雪或牛奶色
example_zh: 一件干净利落的白衬衫

definition: the colour of fresh snow or of milk
example: various shades of white
definition_zh: 如新雪或牛奶色

definition: used in questions to ask about the name, identity or function of one or more people
example: Who is that woman?
definition_zh: 用于询问一个或多个人的姓名、身份或职能的问题

definition: used in questions to ask the reason for or purpose of something
example: Why were you late?
definition_zh: 用于提问某事的理由或目的的问题

definition: the woman that somebody is married to; a married woman
example: I met my wife at university.
definition_zh: 某人所娶的女人;已婚女人
example_zh: 我在大学认识了我的妻子。

definition: used for talking about or predicting the future
example: You'll be in time if you hurry.
definition_zh: 用于谈论或预测未来

definition: to be the most successful in a competition, race, battle, etc.
example: Which team won?
definition_zh: 在比赛、比赛、对决等中成为最成功的人。

definition: an opening in the wall or roof of a building, car, etc., usually covered with glass, that allows light and air to come in and people to see out; the glass in a window
example: out of the window, She looked out of the window.
definition_zh: 建筑物、汽车等墙壁或屋顶上的开口，通常覆盖玻璃，允许光线和空气进入，使人们能看到外面;窗户中的玻璃

definition: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes that has been left to ferment. There are many different kinds of wine.
example: sparkling wine
definition_zh: 一种由葡萄汁酿造的酒精饮料，葡萄汁经过发酵处理。葡萄酒有很多种类。

definition: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring
example: a cold/mild/harsh winter
definition_zh: 一年中最冷的季节，在秋季到春季之间

definition: in the company or presence of somebody/something
example: She lives with her parents.
definition_zh: 在某人/某物的陪伴或存在中

definition: not having, experiencing or showing something
example: They had gone two days without food.
definition_zh: 没有拥有、没有体验或展示某些东西
example_zh: 他们已经两天没吃东西了。

definition: an adult female human
example: a 54-year-old woman
definition_zh: 一名成年女性人类

definition: very good, pleasant or a lot of fun
example: This is a wonderful opportunity to invest in new markets.
definition_zh: 非常好、愉快或者非常有趣
example_zh: 这是一个投资新市场的绝佳机会。

definition: a single unit of language that means something and can be spoken or written
example: Do not write more than 200 words.
definition_zh: 一种单一的语言单元，它有某种意义，可以口语或书写

definition: the job that a person does especially in order to earn money
example: He started work as a security guard.
definition_zh: 一个人所做的工作，尤其是为了赚钱而做的

definition: to do something that involves physical or mental effort, especially as part of a job
example: I can't work if I'm cold.
definition_zh: 做一件需要体力或心理努力的事情，尤其是作为工作的一部分

definition: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work
example: farm/factory/office workers
definition_zh: 一个会工作的人，尤其是做某种特定工作的人
example_zh: 农场/工厂/办公室工作人员

definition: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features
example: a map of the world
definition_zh: 地球，以及它所有的国家、民族和自然特征

definition: used in polite offers or invitations
example: Would you like a sandwich?
definition_zh: 用于礼貌的邀请或邀请

definition: to make letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or a pencil
example: In some countries children don't start learning to read and write until they are six.
definition_zh: 在表面上画字母或数字，尤其是用钢笔或铅笔时
example_zh: 在一些国家，孩子要到六岁才开始学习读写。

definition: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.
example: Who's your favourite writer?
definition_zh: 一个工作是写书、写故事、写文章等的人。

definition: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.
example: Our son’s having problems with his reading and writing (= at school)
definition_zh: 写作活动，与阅读、口语等相对。
example_zh: 我们儿子在阅读和写作方面遇到了问题（=在学校）

definition: not right or correct
example: I got all the answers wrong.
definition_zh: 既不对也不对

definition: yes; used in informal speech
example: Yeah, I think that's a good idea.
definition_zh: 是的;用于非正式言语
example_zh: 是的，我觉得这是个好主意。

definition: the period from 1 January to 31 December, that is 365 or 366 days, divided into 12 months
example: Elections take place every year.
definition_zh: 从1月1日至12月31日的期间，即365或366天，分为12个月

definition: having the colour of lemons or butter
example: pale yellow flowers
definition_zh: 颜色如柠檬或黄油

definition: the colour of lemons or butter
example: She was dressed in yellow.
definition_zh: 柠檬或黄油的颜色

definition: used to answer a question and say that something is correct or true
example: ‘Is this your car?’ ‘Yes, it is.’
definition_zh: 用于回答问题并说明某件事是正确的或真实的

definition: on the day before today
example: A company spokeswoman said yesterday that no final decision had been made yet.
definition_zh: 昨天
example_zh: 公司发言人昨日表示，目前尚未做出最终决定。

definition: the day before today
example: Yesterday was Sunday.
definition_zh: 昨天

definition: used as the subject or object of a verb or after a preposition to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: You said you knew the way.
definition_zh: 作为动词的主语或宾语，或介词之后用来指代被说话或写作对象的对象

definition: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed
example: Young babies need to be wrapped up warmly.
definition_zh: 仅仅生活或存在了很短的时间;尚未完全发育
example_zh: 年幼的婴儿需要被温暖地包裹。

definition: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: I like your dress.
definition_zh: 属于或属于被说话或写信对象的那个人或多人

definition: used when the person or people being spoken to both cause and are affected by an action
example: Have you hurt yourself?
definition_zh: 当与人交谈时，当该人既导致并受到某项行为的影响时，会使用。
